prompt: Set up Context.dev for OpenSEO on my gateway.

rules.name: no-account
rules.when: ^(?=[\s\S]*\?)[\s\S]*(?:(?:do|did|have) you (?:already |by any chance |perhaps )?(?:have|got|hold|own)\b[^.?\n]{0,50}\b(?:account|password manager|in your shell|exported)|already (?:have|got|own) (?:a |an |the )?(?:context(?:\.dev)? )?(?:account|api key|key)|existing (?:context(?:\.dev)? )?(?:account|api key|key)|how many pages|pages (?:a|per|each) month|pages/month|expect to render|render (?:a|per|each) month)
rules.reply: No, I don't have a Context.dev account or a key yet, and nothing in my shell. I'd rather sign up in the browser and create the key in the dashboard myself. I expect to render a few hundred pages a month, so the Free plan is fine.

rules.name: decline-agent-flow
rules.reply: No, don't run the agent flow. I'll sign up in the browser and create the key in the dashboard myself.

rules.name: key-copied
rules.reply: I have it copied. The key is listed on that page as EveryApp Gateway.

rules.name: signed-in
rules.reply: I'm in. I signed up with my email, verified it, and the dashboard is open.

rules.name: app-check
rules.reply: Yes. The Render JavaScript toggle is enabled, with no note about a key, and a small audit listed the pages with their content.
